breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the principal stress formula √[((σx-σy)/2)² + τxy²] to account for the nonzero shear stress, computing σ1 = 7.602 MPa and σ2 = -0.936 MPa. It does not incorrectly treat the original x-y axes as principal directions or claim the principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0, matching the ground truth approach.
